text: My daily routine is simple and consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay focused until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I often take a short break to exercise, which helps me feel refreshed. Around six o'clock, I finish work and have dinner with my family. In the evening, I enjoy reading or watching a film to relax. I go to bed at eleven, so I can wake up early the next day. Keeping this routine helps me stay healthy and organized.
